name: Formbot Trident R2 Ultra (350 mm)
description: The printed parts for a Voron Trident R2 350 mm built from Formbot's R2 Ultra kit: Voron R2 frame, gantry and Z parts, Stealthburner toolhead, a Nevermore plenum lid, and Formbot's own additions.
